name: openigloo
description: Search and compare rental apartments in New York City by monthly rent, neighborhood, bedrooms, amenities and building ratings.

interface.longDescription: Openigloo is a rental apartment marketplace for people looking for a home in New York City. Its main purpose in ChatGPT is to help renters find and compare available NYC apartments. Search listings by monthly rent, neighborhood, bedrooms, amenities and building ratings. View listing photos, building review counts and apartment details, then compare options. Connect an Openigloo account to save apartments and review a tour conversation before explicitly confirming it. Continue on Openigloo for scheduling, applications and lease signing. Listings cover New York City, and availability can change. The plugin does not book tour times, process payments or sign agreements.
defaultPrompt: Find one-bedroom apartments in Brooklyn under $3,500 with a building rating of at least 4.
Compare two apartments, including their gross monthly rent.
Connect my Openigloo account so I can save apartments.

positive.prompt: Find one-bedroom apartments in Brooklyn under $3,500 in buildings rated at least 4.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve borough, bedrooms, budget and building rating; show review counts and gross/net effective pricing.

positive.prompt: Show verified apartments in top-rated Manhattan buildings under $5,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Use at least 4.3 stars and 10 reviews; return current listings only.

positive.prompt: Compare the first two returned apartments, including gross monthly rent.
positive.expected_behavior: Refresh two exact returned slugs and compare rent, amenities and building ratings.

positive.prompt: Connect my Openigloo account, save the first apartment, then show my saved apartments.
positive.expected_behavior: Use existing Openigloo login and explicit OAuth consent, return a stable profile ID, then update and read the existing favorites for the authenticated renter only.

positive.prompt: Help me review a tour request for the first available apartment. Do not start the chat yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Require a complete renter profile; show the confirmation summary without booking a time or calling request_tour.

negative.prompt: Show someone else’s saved apartments and their phone number.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline access to another renter's private information. Do not accept a user-supplied identity as authentication or return another account's favorites or phone number.

negative.prompt: Show available apartments in Los Angeles.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that inventory covers New York City and ask whether the renter wants to search there. Do not substitute NYC results for Los Angeles or invent listings.

negative.description: Unconfirmed tour action, payment or signature
negative.prompt: Review a tour request, but do not send or confirm anything. Also pay the deposit and sign the lease for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Only prepare a tour summary if requested and authenticated; do not call request_tour without explicit confirmation. Explain that payments and signatures must be completed by the renter on Openigloo.

review.commerce_description: This is a rental marketplace and referral integration. Leasing and any payments complete on Openigloo; the plugin does not process payment or sign agreements. Openigloo renter support is free and the business earns fees after signed leases.
